## Why visit

A substantial beer destination that makes St Helens worth considering between the two headline cities. The appeal is the combination of a traditional community pub, an unusually broad cask selection and its own Howzat brewery, rather than a grand tourist interior. Real cider and simple hot food add practical reasons to spend time here. Pair it with the Turks Head for a focused outing built around serious ale and cider. Sport is a significant part of the pub’s operation, so the same room can feel very different during a major match.

## Beer

CAMRA’s September 2026 entry records fourteen handpulls and house beers from the onsite Howzat brewery; actual availability varies.
